item.title: Akatsuki no Goei ~Tsumibukaki Shuumatsuron~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Syangrila
  • 発売日: 2010-04-22
  • スコア: 7.970000000000001/10 (701 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 暁の護衛 ～罪深き終末論～
  • 英語名: Akatsuki no Goei Tsumibukaki Shuumatsuron

别名

  • 暁の護衛 ～罪深き終末論～

あらすじ

Only four more minutes until the hour of reckoning.

—None of them wanted to be born there, to be rejected by society.

The deafening noise of the helicopters reverberates all around Gyoutou, with cameramen straddled on their sides, ready to report what will soon be live news.

—They simply wanted to live.

item.title: Boku to Go-nee to Umi no Year!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Syangrila
  • 発売日: 2007-06-28
  • スコア: 7.07/10 (27 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 僕と極姉と海のYear!!
  • 英語名: Boku to Go-nee to Umi no Year!!

别名

  • Boku to 5 Nee to Umi no Year!!

あらすじ

You play as the grandson of an egomaniacal high-rolling real estate agent. Through his business, he has made connections with many a powerful person. He has recently taken ill and has sent for you to see him. Gladly leaving your dull private school life for a little bit (summer break), you gladly head over to his estate where you used to spend vacations at. Upon your arrival, your grandfather gives you his final orders: to produce a grandchild for him. This should preferably with be done with one of five daughters of a man with a sizable (and highly desired) piece of land. If you succeed, you will become the president of his company. Your failure will result in your deportation to a life at a US military boot camp. Sounds like you better not screw this up!
